`--mode table` prints six lines on stdout:

```bash
relate --read-only --mode table "UNWIND [{name: 'Ada', since: 2024}, {name: 'Grace', since: 2023}] AS p RETURN p.name AS person, p.since AS since, p AS row"
```

```text
| person  | since | row                          |

| "Grace" | 2023  | {name: "Grace", since: 2023} |
+---------+-------+------------------------------+
```
